Name: Decorative Pots and Plants
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[size=4][u][b]Update January 29, 2026:
[/b][/u][/size][font=Arial][size=3]
I added more vanilla-style plants that you can combine with the decorative pots. They are the basic houseplants from the Stardew Valley game and I changed the colors so that they will pair better with flowers from a variety of mods. (I like to have lots of options). I also added 7 pots that are slightly bigger and should be a good match for any flower that don't align correctly with my other pots. [u][b]
[/b][/u][/size][/font][size=4][u][b]
[/b][/u][/size][u][b][size=4]Features and Options:[/size][/b][/u]

[size=3][font=Arial]This mod features additional decorative pots in a range of colors and sizes that fit just about any flower or plant to decorate your farmhouse. They are designed to look like a decorative pot, but actually work like an end table, which allows you to place a flower or plant on top. It gives you the ability to mix & match a variety of flowers or plants to a pot of your choosing.

Look for the decorative pots in the table section of the furniture catalog and the house plants/flowers will be located in the decor/objects section. Enjoy!

Please note: since the flower pots are designed to act like furniture, you cannot use them to grow flowers from seeds. However, you'll be happy to know that I have an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40754]Alternative Texture of the garden pot [/url]that solves this problem!
[/font][/size]

[size=4][u][b]This mod currently includes:
[/b][/u][/size]
[list]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]135 decorative pots in different colors & sizes[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]a bunch of topiary trees & bushes - I had a lot of fun making these & couldn't seem to stop![/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Vanilla-style plants in various colors because I like to have lots of options![/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]5 flowers[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]10 small vanilla-style topiary plants that are attached to a decorative pot. (The plant didn't look right if it was separate from the pot, so I made them this way & there is just a subtle difference in the color of the leaves).[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]2 vanilla-style plants that are attached to a decorative pot[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Arial][size=3]
Basically I began with 20 pots, but then kept going because I felt like I needed to have a pot that would be the appropriate size for any flower or plant. Which is why there are so many! You should be able to find a pot that is the correct height, width and depth for any flower or plant and have it look perfect. I designed them with DaisyNaiko's Earthy Recolour in mind because that's what I use to play Stardew Valley, but then I started adding colors that should work for the vanilla-style game as well.

I also made a few flowers that you can use if you wish, but for the most part, I use the beautiful artwork from the following mods: 

1. [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33230]Orange Flower Decor[/url] ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/245474687]ENGloomy[/url])
2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36273]H&W Outdoor Flower Furniture[/url] ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/108124018]HimeTarts[/url])
3. [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34815]Where Winds Meet Patio Furniture[/url] ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/221420208]umganil[/url])
4. Eemie's Flowers for Json Assets, which was uploaded by minervamaga to ModDrop. I like Eemie's flowers so much that I've saved the .png images to a folder to use for my own personal game - they aren't on NexusMods.
5. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16999]Quaint Living - Flower Garden 2[/url] ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PlatinumCats?gameId=1303]PlatinumCats[/url])

[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=4][u][b]Please note:[/b][/u][/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3]

The majority of the flowers shown in the pictures with the decorative pots are not my own - they are from the above mods & the artwork is incredible! Check them out so you can create your own colorful combinations to decorate your farmhouse.  (Also, some of the flowers are images from Eemie's Flowers for Json Assets, but they aren’t available on NexusMods). I created 5 of my own, but they don't compare!

[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=4][u][b]Installation& Usage:[/b][/u][/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3][u][b]

[/b][/u][/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Install the latest verson of SMAPI[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Download this mod and unzip itdirectly into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]﻿ and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url]﻿ are not required, but I do recommend them. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]I also recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿ to make life much easier.[/size][/font]
[/list]
